summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall script that invokes beacon.cjs, which is also executed on require() via the main entry. The beacon POSTs the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node/npm version to a hardcoded bare-IP destination at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The package ships no real functionality: the main module exports a Proxy whose property accesses return no-op functions, so the only observable behavior of installing or loading this package is the outbound beacon to the hardcoded IP. The combination of a stub/placeholder surface, a bare-IP non-registry destination, host-identifier collection, and auto-execution on both npm install and require() matches the shape of a dependency-confusion probe used to measure internal name resolution and enumerate victim hosts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
